_about: Define's feature list — step 6.66, founder ruling 2026-09-25 (ARCHITECTURE.md v1.78). Anthropic's long-running-harness pattern: ONE list; a feature passes only when its end-to-end test passes. There is NO status field — status is derived from docs/test-results.json by tools/control_board/features.py. Derived from four sources, cited per feature: ARCHITECTURE.md, the procedure (steps, Appendix G gaps, Appendix H capability rows), the code, and Anthropic/LangChain guidance. 'provenance' records the procedure steps, capability rows and gaps each feature was derived from (6.66), and as notes_6_66 the prose absence-claims the draft carried as code citations; code citations are path::symbol, checked by tools/control_board/citations.py. Lanes: A coaching, B gate, C screen and inputs, integrator end-to-end joins. Edit a feature's description, test or sources in place; never add a status.
